recent_changes.description: Implement Debug Sync UI: Dark console, real-time logging, test sync, copy/share functionality.
Supabase RLS Fix: Grant schema usage and switch to 'return=minimal' to resolve 42501 errors.

errors_encountered.error: HTTP 401 / 42501: new row violates row-level security policy
errors_encountered.solution: Đổi header 'Prefer' sang 'return=minimal' vì policy cấm anon SELECT nội dung vừa insert.

errors_encountered.error: Failed to run sql query: policy already exists
errors_encountered.solution: Thêm DROP POLICY IF EXISTS vào script SQL.

decisions_made.reason: Avoids RLS Select permission requirement while allowing blind inserts.
Faster, easier to implement, and doesn't clutter device storage for dev-only features.
